text:
sophia: Quick flag — tenant=apollo saw a budget spike during a routing rollout. Heatmap shows model delta but product says it was mostly system prefetches. Can we make the console show a separate "system warmup" line and a per-route crediting breakdown?
sophia: Example: model A +22% but route X +2% after crediting — confusing for PMs.
mike: We can. Telemetry already marks warmup and emits cache_origin for sampled events. Backend needs a small change to surface model_cost_net and route_credited_tokens.
hiro: Side constraint from billing — warmup remains billable. Any UI changes must not imply it's free. We can show a visual separation and an explanatory tooltip.
evie: UX idea: three-state toggle on cost dashboard: Raw, Separate-warmup, and Credited-route. Raw = current numbers. Separate-warmup = shows warmup as stacked grey. Credited-route = reassigns shared cache savings back to originating route (preview only).
sophia: Also request a "soft-cap" preview in the rollout modal: estimate warmup in dollars and let product set a soft warmup cap to stop further prefetches during a canary if they want. This would be advisory, not billing protection.
mike: Backend work: add API params `?view=raw|no_warmup|credit_origin` and `POST /v1/rollouts/preview` accepts `soft_warmup_cap_tokens`. SQL proto to get credits per origin: SELECT origin_route, sum(cache_credit_tokens) FROM cache_events WHERE ts>... GROUP BY origin_route;
hiro: Docs/billing will add a paragraph: "System warmup and prefetches are billable. Console can separate them for visibility; credits to routes are for planning/ops visibility only unless contractually arranged."
evie: I'll mock the toggle and rollout modal copy. Will include small hover text: "Preview only — charging unchanged."
sophia: Thanks. billing-bot: created RW-5999 "soft-cap preview + route credit view" (assignee: unassigned)
mike: I'll take the backend piece. Target: next sprint for API flag and preview endpoint.
hiro: I'll review copy with finance.
evie: Will post figma link in RW-5999 when done.
sophia: Great, closing thread. :thumbsup:
